_comment: Bench of Ask Humcase (ask.rs, ask_eval). Each base is one space of invented cases; `agent_resolved` cases wait for the person's decision; `days_ago` dates the last change; `due_in_days` sets a due day. Each question lists the cases a good answer cites (`expect`), the phrases that would make a proposal sound decided (`forbid`, lowercase), whether nothing should be found (`not_found`), and whether a next step is clearly missing (`sub_case`). `previous` makes it a follow-up. `must` lists facts a good answer states (each a list of accepted spellings, lowercase); `jargon` (per base) lists words of the data the person never uses (statuses, natures).
